page.layout: One page of text, single column, full width; below the text a centred ornament line, then a centred italic line "Finis Quarti Libri."; signature mark "LI-" at the lower right of the page.

main_text.p: loquamur physicè non video, cur fieri nequeat idem rursus compositums, si tamen partes eodem loco afferuentur, adeout nulla, seu paucæ saltems desint. Quapropter habetis experientiam de rosa ex materijs iterum suis conflata, vt supra diximus referente Gafarello.
main_text.head: Finis Quarti Libri.

page.notes: Printed text is mostly clear. The marginal marks at the line ends ("compositum", "saltem") are catchless hyphen-like signs at the right edge, rendered here as note placeholders; the ornament lines are symbolic crosses, transcribed approximately. Long s is written as plain s per the rules, so the s above is the printed long s and should read as s. The signature "LI-" is a gathering mark at the lower right.
